semiconductor_relevance: High - BMT specializes in ultra-high purity (UHP) fittings, valves, and gas delivery systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: BMT Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of ultra-high purity fittings and valves, providing essential components for gas delivery systems in semiconductor fabrication. Their SUPERLOK brand is recognized for quality and reliability, serving major industry players like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

regional_presence.Korea: BMT has established partnerships with major semiconductor companies such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
